crossRefs.note: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;
translations.bsb: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
translations.kjv: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
translations.asv: Only the tribe of Levi thou shalt not number, neither shalt thou take the sum of them among the children of Israel;
